firstRun.privacy.title: Your privacy
firstRun.privacy.summary: Wayfare gives this phone a random install ID so your language and settings stay with it. You don't need an account. Location is asked for later, only when you start walking, to find places near you.

walk.notice.system.title: Your phone stopped the walk
walk.notice.system.message: It closed Wayfare in the background to save battery. {count, plural, =0 {No places heard.} one {# place heard.} other {# places heard.}}
walk.notice.foregroundOnly.title: Walking only while Wayfare is open
walk.notice.foregroundOnly.message: When the screen is off, the walk stops listening. Allow location all the time to walk with your phone in your pocket.
walk.notice.revoked.title: Background location is off
walk.notice.revoked.message: Your walk now listens only while Wayfare is open.
walk.explainer.background.title: Hear stories as you walk
walk.explainer.background.body: To tell you about each place as you reach it — with your phone in your pocket — Wayfare needs your location while a walk is on, even when the screen is off.
walk.explainer.background.private: Your route is never stored or shared.
walk.explainer.background.listens: It listens only during a walk, and stops when the walk stops.
walk.explainer.background.change: Change it any time in Settings.
walk.explainer.onlyOpen: Only while the app is open
walk.explainer.background.footnote: Next, Android opens a settings page. Choose "Allow all the time".
walk.step.title: One more step, in Android's settings
walk.step.intro: Android opens Wayfare's location page. Choose:
walk.step.back: Then come back with the back button. The walk starts by itself.
walk.android.whileUsing: Allow only while using the app
walk.explainer.notifications.title: See your walk at a glance
walk.explainer.notifications.body: While you walk, Wayfare shows a notification so you know the walk is on. Tap it to see your walk or stop it.
walk.explainer.notifications.nothingElse: Nothing else: no offers, no reminders.
walk.explainer.notifications.refuse: If you say no, the walk still runs, but Android may hide its notification.
walk.explainer.notifications.footnote: Next, Android asks whether Wayfare may send notifications.
walk.denied.title: A walk needs your location
walk.denied.body: Wayfare uses it to know when you reach a place. Without it you can still explore the map and play any story yourself.
walk.denied.forever: Android won't ask again. In Settings, open Permissions › Location and choose "Allow only while using the app" or "Allow all the time".
walk.help.title: Keep Wayfare walking
walk.help.intro: Some phones close apps in the background to save battery, which stops your walk. These settings keep it going. Wayfare only works in the background while a walk you started is on.
walk.help.restricted: Android is limiting Wayfare in the background on this phone.
walk.help.battery.how: In Wayfare's app settings, under Battery & performance.
walk.help.autostart.how: In Settings › Apps › Permissions › Background autostart, turn on Wayfare.
walk.help.lock.how: Open Recent apps, long-press Wayfare, tap the lock.
walk.help.unrestricted.how: Settings › Apps › Wayfare › Battery (on some phones, "App battery usage").
walk.help.sleeping.how: Samsung: Settings › Battery › Background usage limits.
walk.help.differ: Menu names differ between phones and Android versions.
settings.walk.location.hint: Needed to hear places with the screen off
settings.walk.keep.hint: For phones that stop apps in the background
walk.notification.title: Walking with Wayfare

settings.diagnostics.walkLogEmpty: There is no walk log yet.
code.permission.title: Scan a Wayfare code
code.permission.body: Wayfare uses the camera only to read the code on a Wayfare sticker, then plays that place's story — no GPS needed, so it works indoors.
code.permission.noPhotos: No photos are taken or kept.
code.permission.staysOnPhone: Nothing from the camera leaves your phone.
code.permission.onlyWhileOpen: The camera is on only while the scanner is open.
code.permission.footnote: Next, Android asks whether Wayfare may use the camera.
code.denied.title: The scanner needs the camera
code.denied.body: Without it, you can still type the 8-character code printed under the QR.
code.denied.forever: Android won't ask again. In Settings, open Permissions › Camera and choose "Allow only while using the app".
code.scanner.tooDark: Too dark? Turn on the torch
code.scanner.notWayfare: That's not a Wayfare code. Look for the Wayfare sticker.
code.type.title: Type the code
code.type.where: Type the 8 letters and numbers printed under the QR on the Wayfare sticker.
code.type.label: Code
code.type.helper: 8 characters — lower case, spaces and hyphens are fine.
code.type.letterU: Wayfare codes never use the letter U. Check the sticker.
code.lookingUp.title: Looking up {code}…
code.lookingUp.body: This place isn't on your phone yet.
code.noLonger.title: This place is no longer on Wayfare
code.noLonger.body: Its story can't play any more. Other places nearby are on the map.
code.noSuch.title: No place has the code {code}
code.noSuch.body: Check the 8 characters against the sticker, or scan the QR instead.
code.badLink.title: This link doesn't lead to a place
code.badLink.body: Scan the Wayfare sticker, or type the code printed under it.
code.offline.title: You're offline
code.offline.body: This place isn't on your phone yet. Connect to the internet and try again.
